title: Kiln runtime bundle manifest (kiln-runtime.json in kiln-runtime-<semver>+<date.gitsha>.zip), format 1
description: Root entry of a runtime bundle. The zip is deterministic (sorted entries, fixed times, no extra attributes); its files are laid out relative to the game folder (dinput8.dll, kiln/...). Built by tools/package + kilnctl bundle create; installed by kiln_manage::install.

created.description: Commit time (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH), not build time: keeps the zip deterministic.

profileReader.description: The profile.json forms the runtime's kiln-core reads (native/core/src/profile.h KILN_PROFILE_READER). Absent: 1, a runtime from before the field. 2: Copy mode's paths out of kiln/ are read: ../mods/<folder> in mods.eml (and mods.xhl), ../greeneye/<id> in mods.greeneye. 3: also ../mods/<id> in mods.flame. The launcher writes each form only for a runtime that declares its revision.

default.description: Installed unless the user deselects it.

components.description: Known names: core (proxy, core, host, dotnet, sigdb, services), admin (Kiln.Admin), emf (kiln-emf plugin), eml (kiln-eml), shroudforge (ShroudForge runtime), enshwick (Enshwick loader), samples.

path.description: Relative to the game folder, '/' separators, sorted bytewise.

config.description: User-editable (kiln/kiln.json): installed only when missing, never replaced or deleted.

builds.description: Game builds this bundle's sigdb verifies (sigdb/builds/<side>/<sha256>.json with verified: true).
